title: Remove Duplicates from a List
description: Remove duplicate values from a list while preserving the original order.
code:
numbers = [1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5, 1]
unique = []

for n in numbers:
    if n not in unique:
        unique.append(n)

print("Original:", numbers)
print("Unique:", unique)
